-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem etcdFs_start [GoGlobalContext] (σ : state) (h : Fs.FsInit (extLocal Fs.fsExt σ.world)) : ⊢
    extsLocalStart σ.world ={⊤}=∗ Fs.osInv ∗ ([∗map] i ↦ f ∈ (extLocal Fs.fsExt σ.world).fs.files,
    Fs.osFileStart i f) ∗ Fs.osTree (DFrac.own 1) (extLocal Fs.fsExt σ.world).fs.roots ((extLocal
    Fs.fsExt σ.world).fs.treeDur, [])

  Fs.StepPrem.and (fun [GooseExts] [GoGlobalContext] => Fs.NoIoErr allIo) fun [GooseExts] [GoGlobalContext] =>
    Fs.NoMapLockErr allIo
